(M. Tărnăuceanu). Is it true that for every positive rational number r there
exists a finite group G such that | Aut(G)|/|G| = r?
    A similar question is answered in the positive for graphs, monoids, partial groups,
and posets (R. Molinier, Preprint, 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.21059). It
is also known that the set {| Aut(G)|/|G| | G is a finite abelian group} is dense in
[0, +∞) (M. Tărnăuceanu, Elemente Math. (2025), https://ems.press/journals/
em/articles/14298544).                                                     R. Molinier
  ∗ Yes, it is true (S. Sureaux, Preprint, 2026,
https://kourovkanotebookorg.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/
21.97-automorphism-ratios-of-finite-groups.pdf).
